what: From integrate-tooling, for coord-1030's build: build_release.py --server now builds the proc-macro server with v2 (`blaze build --release -p proc-macro-srv-cli --bin blaze-proc-macro-srv`, BLAZE_HOME and CARGO_TARGET_DIR in a temp dir, `blaze stop` after, the binary copied from target/release) in place of the v1 `--crate ... --exe` form. Worth one run in a VM: `python3 .github/scripts/build_release.py --target <host> --out shipped --no-pgo --server`. release.yaml's `blaze-engine std` step and the std assets (out/manifests.* packs.* keys.*) are removed: std crates are units in blaze-cas, built like any other; the library-*.tar.xz source archive (crates/blaze-cargo/src/toolchain/library.rs) stays.
